snippet.title: The Field Between Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3962310/The_Field_Between/

The Field Between is a psychological horror farming simulator, manage your very own farm, buying crops, planting them, watching them grow, and selling them off to your customers, all the while expanding your farm and improving your reputation.

During the day, customers will arrive to your farm, looking for specific orders, complete these to earn money, which you can spend on new crops, fertilisers, upgrading your farm, or upgrading your tools to improve your progress and earn more money. The better you do, the higher your reputation will rise, getting you better offers from customers and earning you even more money, slowly build your farming empire up from the humble patch of grass you started with.

Make sure to deal with all your customers before night falls, as any remaining will become agitated and offer you reduced rewards, then use your remaining time to clean and set up for the next day. When you're ready, head to bed and get some well deserved sleep, just try not to have any dreams...
